key_insight: SparkVSR makes VSR controllable by letting users provide or edit a small number of high-quality keyframes which are then propagated to the rest of the video, enabling reliable correction of artifacts with minimal user effort.
problem_solved: Most VSR methods are black boxes at inference time—users cannot fix unexpected artifacts or guide reconstruction. This paper addresses the need for an interactive, user-controllable VSR pipeline that achieves high quality with sparse supervision.
method: Treat a sparse set of user-provided super-resolved keyframes as an explicit control signal.
Learn a propagation module that transfers high-frequency details from keyframes to neighboring frames with temporal consistency and occlusion-aware blending.
Design for interactivity and efficiency so users can iteratively edit few keyframes and quickly update the whole video.
impact: Enables human-in-the-loop VSR workflows where practitioners or end-users can correct artifacts, steer output quality, and reduce compute by focusing effort on a few keyframes—improving trust and practicality of VSR systems.

paper_title: SparkVSR: Interactive Video Super-Resolution via Sparse Keyframe Propagation
paper_authors: Jiongze Yu, Xiangbo Gao, Pooja Verlani, Akshay Gadde, Yilin Wang
